overview_description.description: Paystack lets businesses in Africa accept payments from anyone, anywhere in the world via credit card, debit card, money transfer, and mobile money on their websites or mobile apps. The platform offers easy-to-use features like linking bank accounts, sending money in a few steps, and saving recipients for quick payments. With Paystack, businesses can accept payments from customers anywhere in the world, enhancing their ability to grow and reach new markets.

about_short_description.short_description: Paystack fintech company that facilitates online and offline payments for businesses across Africa.

product.name: Paystack Payment Gateway
product.description: An online and offline payment platform that enables African businesses to accept card, bank, transfer, USSD, mobile money, QR, Apple Pay, and POS payments.

product.name: Paystack APIs
product.description: A set of APIs and developer tools for integrating payments, transfers, customer data retrieval, and identity verification into websites, applications, and financial products.

product.name: Paystack Terminal
product.description: An in-person payments service for accepting card, bank transfer, and USSD payments through Paystack’s terminal and virtual terminal offerings.

product.name: Paystack Commerce
product.description: A commerce toolkit for selling physical and digital products online through storefronts, payment pages, order management, and inventory tools.

product.name: Paystack Transfers
product.description: A payout service for sending money to bank accounts individually or in bulk through the Paystack Dashboard or API.

product.name: Paystack Dashboard
product.description: A merchant management dashboard for monitoring transactions, settlements, customers, reports, refunds, chargebacks, permissions, and reconciliation.
